admission.justification: Log-only sizing with tolerated framing is proved by the named passing stats test; single-file member of the family.

applicability: The tool-log-stats command over a log folder and day span.
conditions: Sizes are read from the log lines only.
Blank and malformed lines are skipped.
exclusions: Writing, repairing or pruning the log, which the command never does.
Live server state, which the command does not observe.
statement: The read-only tool-log-stats command sizes per-tool/operation calls, medians, p90, max, sums and guard-cut rates from the log folder only, skipping blank and malformed lines.
